tagline: A pinch of city with your coffee

title: Festival lights up {district}
Streets dance in {district}
body: The party ran until midnight. "Busier than a holiday," said one shopkeeper; the budget got thinner, spirits got higher.

title: After the party: confetti and tea glasses
body: Crews were out at dawn. Expect a little dust in the air for a day.

title: Rain falls, cafés fill up
body: Not a free table in town. "We can't brew tea fast enough," laughed a barista.

title: Heatwave grips the city
body: Asphalt softened and ice-cream queues grew. Stay in the shade and drink water.

title: Parks save the day in {district}
body: Tree shade was the hottest property in town this week.

title: First snow of the year!
body: Snowmen appeared on every corner; traffic slowed to a crawl.

title: Morning fog slows the roads
body: Visibility dropped and so did speeds. Patience, drivers.

title: Drivers fed up in {district}
body: Hours in evening traffic sparked a wave of complaints. Calls for transit and bike lanes grow.

title: Petition for bike lanes
body: Starting in {district}, hundreds have signed for protected bike lanes. The mayor's move.

title: New bakery opens in {district}
body: The queue for fresh bread turned the corner on day one.

title: Lost cat Pamuk is home
body: Found asleep on a café chair in {district}. The café promised free milk for life.

title: Weekend concert in the park
body: Blankets, dogs and a saxophone: the best gathering of the weekend.

title: Power cut in {district}
body: A transformer failed; neighbours chatted by candlelight until crews fixed it.

title: Council debates the power grid
body: "Plan first, then cables," was the mood in the chamber.

title: Start-up chooses Nefeskent
body: A new office in {district} is hiring. Good news for job seekers.

title: Pothole season is open
body: Crews patched the roads in {district}; expect slow traffic.

title: Autumn colours in the parks
body: {district} turned yellow and orange; cameras clicked all day.

title: Storm batters the city
body: Roof tiles flew and trees fell in {district}. Repairs come out of the budget.

title: Night market packed
body: Stalls, lights and live music: the city's new evening favourite.

title: Tourists discover Nefeskent
body: Green and happy, the city is suddenly on everyone's map.

title: New homes ready: {building}
body: Moving vans lined the street; new neighbours already joined the balcony chats.

title: {building} opens its doors
body: The free tea at the opening ran out in minutes.

title: {building} opens for business
body: Desks set, coffee machines on. Job ads are already up.

title: New green space: {building}
body: Benches filled and swings never stopped. The air feels cleaner already.

title: {building} now in service
body: First riders boarded after the ribbon cutting. Traffic relief expected.

title: Population hits {population}!
body: The city crossed a new threshold. Plans for schools and parks are on the table.

title: Gridlock!
body: Rush hour filled the main roads around {district}. Transit and bike lanes are the talk of the town.

title: New city policy: {policy}
body: Effects are expected in the coming days.

title: {policy} in effect
body: The decision is now visible on the streets. Everyone is talking about it.

title: {policy} repealed
body: Supporters are disappointed, critics relieved.

title: Storm warning
body: Strong winds and downpours expected.

title: Snow is falling
body: Roads are slippery; a perfect day for kids.

title: Thick fog
body: Visibility is low. Drive slowly.

title: The city wakes from a long sleep
body: While the mayor was away, the city kept quietly living.

title: Building demolished: {building}
body: What comes next is the question on everyone's lips.

title: A quiet day
body: Nothing major to report. Sometimes the best news is no news.

title: Poll: residents are happy
body: Most people on the street say they love living here.

title: Poll: residents restless
body: More green, less traffic, says the street.

title: Traffic tests everyone's patience
body: Metro and bike lane ideas come up in every conversation.

title: A green capital in the making
body: Parks and rooftop gardens keep the air clean.

title: City coffers under strain
body: Costs are outpacing income. Balance first, experts say.

title: Coffers full, ideas ready
body: A great time for new parks, transit and culture projects.

title: New mayor takes office
body: The town's new mayor started work today. Every café asks the same question: what will they do first?
